items.title: Stuck on random seed
items.body:
### What happened?

Hi BepInEx Team! I'm having a issue with my friend, she's managed to not be able to get past the "Random seed" Screen, at first i thought it was a Steam deck thing, however in my Windows machine it's happening the same way, the host is able to play but the invited player is not being stuck on random seed.

I am not pressuring anyone here so take your time if this is a difficult issue, Or it is not related to BepInEx at all, i would like to know what caused it so i can either remove or drop it entirely. Here's the Thunderstore code and Thank you all in advance!

0191873f-22e1-65c3-afe6-a753d856d444

### Steps to reproduce

You open lethal company (Modded) you join up (Both as host and Player) You land on a moon but the other player won't be able to land, remaining on the Random Seed screen.

### BepInEx Distribution

3rd party distribution

### Log outputs

```txt
I'll provide them under the comments since the logs are a bit long
```


### Environment

```markdown
- OS: Windows 11 & (Steam OS Latest version on steam deck)
- BepInEx: Latest thunderstore version.
- Game: Lethal Company.
```

Valheim proceeds to launch just fine, and shows that it has been launched with mods but then I get the same errors when trying to connect to a Modded server. I had him import mods via file from my own Modman and I am the server host and can connect without issues. Another member can also connect without issue. We assume the issue is with Steam and not R2Modman but figured I would start here. items.title: Update Bepin GOs to use HideAndDontSave flags
items.body:
## Description
To prevent forceful destruction of the manager GOs by the game (see Oddworld: Soulstorm) via
`Resources.UnloadUnusedAssets` we can use https://docs.unity3d.com/ScriptReference/HideFlags.HideAndDontSave.html

## Motivation and Context
 Oddworld: Soulstorm (for example) uses aggressive resource management approach that forcefully unloads any objects, including those that were set to DontDestroyOnLoad(). There are 3 possible workarounds:
1. Move away from GameObjects (unlikely, breaking)
2. Use custom loaders for specific game that will patch game's code (unlikely, not relevant to Bepin itself)
3. Resort to easier solution via custom object flags that will prevent it from being unloaded.

## How Has This Been Tested?
Preliminary testing on ` Oddworld: Soulstorm` (custom build of Unity 2019.4.12) for about an hour. Plugins used to be destroyed and unloaded after first scene change, now they persist.
